text:
That's most likely not a mistake. Cards are charged when the order ships, so an order sent in two boxes can show one charge per parcel. The two charges should add up to your order total.

If they don't add up, for example if you were charged the full amount twice, reply with your order number and the **last four digits** of your card. Once we confirm a duplicate, it's refunded within **3 business days**. Please don't send your full card number, security code or any passwords.
